title: Review of c22's metabolic-crawler no-fission negative: Supported on fresh seed 3. At ksyn 0.2 one crawler grows to a saturating area of ~6.8 with one front; at ksyn 0.4 it grows to 47% of the box (area ~17), still one cell and one front, with 0 splits to t=60
summary: labkit runs of c22's metabolic crawler (world.py of 20261025T2238, unchanged; WORLD_P SYN_RIM=1, kdeg 0.1, rn 0.25, L=6, N=300) on fresh seed 3 to t=60. At ksyn 0.2, c22's setting: one component throughout, 0 splits, and occupancy 0.131 / 0.163 / 0.179 / 0.189 at t=15/30/45/60, so area about 4.7 -> 6.8 and saturating, matching c22's 6.71. The cell crawls 11.4 body lengths. At ksyn 0.4: still one component, 0 splits, and occupancy 0.282 / 0.395 / 0.447 / 0.472 (area about 17 at t=60, still rising slowly). k04/sheet.png shows one large teardrop with a single polarized band at one end, not two fronts. Doubling the feed again makes a bigger crawler, not two, so the negative extends to a 2x higher uptake.

observations.D: k02/FACTS.md and k04/FACTS.md: 1 component throughout, 0 splits, 0 persistent splits to t=60 (the negative replicates); k04/sheet.png t=26-60: one cell with one polarized band

seeds_run.result: pass (negative replicates): ksyn 0.2, area ~6.8 saturating, no fission
ksyn 0.4: area ~17 (47% of box), still one cell, no fission

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed per feed level. At ksyn 0.4 the cell fills half the 6x6 box, so a larger box might allow shapes the periodic box suppresses. Areas are taken from labkit occupancy x 36.
